boundaries: Real packaged App pointer/keyboard selections, dialogs, tray and input-only raw PTYs. Public IPC creates own two tasks/project and stops own task; observer delays original authenticated RPC input/response unchanged. Real same-path inode replacement produces original source refusal. No model, clipboard, Store/editor/DOM value mutation, forged receipts or daily data. CM state is read-only for selection/document assertions.

No physical IME, system clipboard, external model/CLI run, full reference pixel parity or other-platform completion claimed. P is not a required layer for H34/S08; approved existing tray/dialog visual design is unchanged.
Old conflict case H18 has a documented source/confirmed prototype semantics mismatch; its expected and unexecuted status remain unchanged pending clarification. No unauthorized scope adjustment.

App unavailable/stopped target, cancel/clear/root predispatch, obsolete editor capture, genuine prewrite refusal, original matching/obsolete late receipts, exact truncation and aggregate payload limits are separately observed. Native I uses original FileService/scoped RPC/packaged broker, synthetic sender metadata; only designated existing rows use actual PTY.
First fixture, strict identity schema and regression precondition failures preserved; only external drivers/tests changed. No new product repair or repackage claimed.
